title: Conditions on the Share of the Controls Site Survey Fee Taken after a Long Outage
content:
# Conditions on the Share of the Controls Site Survey Fee Taken after a Long Outage

**Condition 1.** Where the site has stood without monitoring for longer than the tier's restart window and the twelve months to the handling day carry no software update applied to the covered system, half the tier's controls site survey fee — 50 per cent of it — is taken on the reinstatement charge of the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans.

**Condition 2.** Where the site has stood without monitoring for longer than the tier's restart window and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one software update applied to the covered system, a quarter of that survey fee, that is 25 per cent of it, is taken.

**Condition 3.** In every other case no share of the tier's controls site survey fee is taken.

**Condition 4.** The share so taken is worked to two decimal places.

| Days the site has stood without monitoring, against the tier's restart window | Software updates applied to the covered system in the twelve months to the handling day | Share of the tier's controls site survey fee taken |
|---|---|---|
| longer than the window | none | half of it |
| longer than the window | at least 1 | a quarter of it |
| within the window | any number | none |

## Boundary reading

A site that has stood without monitoring for exactly as many days as the tier's restart window is within the window, both conditions needing longer than it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

At a tier whose restart window is 45 days and whose controls site survey fee is 650 USD: a site 70 days without monitoring with no software update in the twelve months carries 325.00 USD; the same site with one update applied carries 162.50 USD; a site 45 days or fewer without monitoring carries nothing on this line.
